---
title: "Applied Data Analytics"
---

## Overview

Course will cover the following:

- data fetching/preprocessing
- domains:
  - geoscience
  - finance/economics
  - knowledge graphs
  - astronomy
  - genomics
- visualization/presentation (e.g. Gradio)
- LLM toolkits (LangChain/LangFlow)
- ML Pipelines (MLFlow/KubeFlow/AirFlow/Prefect/Metaflow)
- MLOps
- Amazon Web Services
- Docker
